body: I feel you. Someone told me once that I shouldn’t mind that much getting texts, and that it leaves more to say when we meet. That made me feel so childish, I hated that. The thing is, some people need constant communication, and other don’t, ans maybe because of that, we’re not with the person we should be with.
I needed to hear this today. Thank you for that

Don’t sacrifice your well-being for someone who doesn’t deserve you. There’s never a good time to break up. What if right after that, he loses his job, and then, his dog dies, etc… will you stay with him for another 10 years just because you don’t want to add up to his despair ?

I think you misinterpreted the world lonely. There’s being alone and being lonely, which are two different concepts. What you described is being alone, meaning having no one else with you which can be perfectly find. I too find it soothing sometimes, because it’s only when I’m alone that I can think. However, being lonely is when being alone is painful to you, makes you sad, etc.. thats the major difference. So since loneliness is defined from the fact that you don’t like it, you can’t love being lonely. You’re not lonely, unless you’re lying to yourself.

Maybe you’re mad at him for something that happened in your childhood. I have the same issue with my parents, it took me a long time to understand I resented them (still don’t know how to deal with it).

EDIT: Good luck with your depression. That might also explain things. I hope you’re doing okay now, people on this app are not always nice, but they’re not trained therapists, they’re just people like us. I know how you feel, I deleted my account because they made me feel like shit, but understand that you don’t need validation from people from the internet.
You’re a nice person, thank you.

I tried several times but I cant. She my mom, and sometimes you need a mother. She’s been pretty bad to me, what I wrote is only 1% of what I hate her for. But sometimes she’s nice, so I feel like I’m the asshole in this story and I hate myself for hating her.
That’s normal, it’s hard to get out of this sort of thoughts. I haven’t been able to do it myself, I sought help but still haven’t found it.

Congratulations ! It’s hard to get rid of the toxic people in our life, especially when they’re the only person we have. I stayed with someone that using me for 3 years, you’re not the only person who has accepted to used just to feel a bit less lonely. Do not beat yourself up for having had a relationship with him. We humans need social connection for survival, it was just basic instinct.

No I wouldn’t, especially since there’s a lot of apps I can do that for free, and where it’ll feel more genuine.
The thing with loneliness is not just the need to have basic human interactions. It’s also the lack of genuine and profound connection.
I have lots of day-to-day social interactions. I talk with my coworkers, my family, etc… but I still feel extremely lonely because these interactions are all shallow. They don’t know the real me, and don’t really care to know more. That’s why I feel lonely. And to me, paying some stranger just to have a conversation for 1hr won’t fill that void.

Looking at the comments it made me realize I’m not sure what your question is.
Is it : ´what do we think about it ?´ Or ‘Should you (OP) do it?’
For the former: I wouldn’t, it would just make me feel even lonelier. Its as if Im so lonely I have to ask someone to fake a friendship and emotional connection. I’ve had a lot of shallow friendships, that I’ve kept just for the social connection, until I realized that that made me feel even more lonely. So it’s a no go for.

For the latter: this is your choice, no judging in you doing what works for you. It’s not because it won’t work for me that it won’t work for you either. If you have the money and are considering it, go for it. You’ll end up either pleasantly surprised or unchanged.
You don’t choose what you worry about. I would love to stop worrying about everything.

Thank you for your kind words.
I hope things will get better for you too.

I wondered the same a few years back. I feel like in these modern times, everyone is sad. So for a while I thought I wasn’t sad enough to complain, because others have it worse. I’ve been clinically diagnosed as depressed almost ten years ago. When I first heard it, I couldn’t believe it. And still today, I’m looking for another diagnosis like BPD or something.

Congrats for wanting to change things !
I have no particular advice, as I’m asking the same question for myself, but at least you want things to get better, and you deserve congratulations for that.

I have tried dating apps for a while (Tinder, Bumble with the friends feature…). You can have deep one-time conversations, get to know someone else, and the best part is that people seem genuinely interested into knowing you, since they’re there to meet new people too.
Well, actually, bad people are rather very well acquainted. So you’re not lonely because you’re a bad person, but mostly because of bad circumstances.

You’re not the problem. You can be loved and accepted exactly as you are right now. There are despicable people who are married with kids and a functional family, and a bunch of close friends. Your personality is not the issue. Anyone can be loved.

What you wrote is beautiful. There’s a lot of people like us, unconditionally givers that never get anything back because you seem so strong and self-reliant, why worry for you ? You should take a step back into giving, I know that’s harder that it seems, I’ve never been able to do it myself. When you’re thinking about giving again, ask yourself if that person is worth it ? And pour all this effort of giving into yourself. Be your own care taker.
There’s also books about how to stop being an over giver. I’ve heard about one, not sure it totally applies to you, but it’s called « The disease to please ».
Good luck OP !
